promises.area: Care for older and disabled adults

versions.text: Continue our pioneering policy of free adult home care for every resident in need, because when people need care they should face kindness, not anxiety about cost.

events.text: Kept in the 2026/27 budget adopted by Full Council: the council says it is the only council in the country to provide free home care, helping 1,623 residents (budget report, PDF page 22)
Re-pledged in the 2026 Labour manifesto
Labour manifesto for the council elections of 22 May 2014: "we will abolish home care charges", which were then £12 an hour (PDF page 18)

Cabinet report, 2 February 2015: Cabinet approved ending home care charges on 31 March 2015, giving up £441,000 a year of income; the minutes call it a manifesto commitment delivered (report paragraphs 2.1 and 10.2)

Full Council minutes, 25 February 2015: councillors voted 25 to 0, with 15 not voting, to abolish home care charges on 31 March 2015; the £324,000 a year net cost was met from savings elsewhere in the 2015/16 budget (Cabinet report, paragraph 10.2)
Full Council report, 17 October 2024: the council has not charged for home care since 1 April 2015, and says it is the only council in England not to (page 1)

promises.editor_note: Earlier history (the 2014 pledge, the 2015 decisions and the end of charges) added 8 Oct 2026 from the 2014 manifesto and the council's own papers, read in full (PRE_SHIP_REVIEW B3).
